title: Signature three-step shrink
description: A Signature reproduction discipline: every failure is reduced to the smallest input that still triggers it before anyone is allowed to debug.
signature_principle: Debug the smallest failing case, never the original dump.
signature_method: Bisect the input, the steps, and the environment until each is minimal.
signature_steps: Capture the failing case|Bisect inputs until minimal|Bisect steps until minimal|Debug only the minimal case
signature_advantage: Debugging time collapses; minimal cases become regression tests.
